about: src/lib/menu_import_vectors.json is a byte-for-byte copy of madar-shared's file at this tag (madar-menu: the Foodics reader, the bulk menu checks and the replace sentence; features/menu-import/util.test.ts runs the wasm against it). A change is made there, released with a tag, and copied here with the tag and hash below updated; scripts/check-shared-vectors.sh (CI) and shared_vectors.test.ts check it.
